title: Outreach day: what the tile becomes at each size
question: Each size gets a designed layout instead of being refused. Which layouts should Outreach day offer? Good alternatives stay selectable in the tile's settings; you pick defaults per size.

options.label: Map card
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: A map of the routes behind the words; shown once Outreach draws real routes.
